description: Manage recurring types of technical vendor decisions through intake, evidence comparison and independent review in separate Agent contexts.

requires.python: >=3.9 standard library on macOS or Linux
requires.model: Operator-configured Ask model/credentials, no credentials bundled
requires.review: Separate context review plus human judgment; numeric and byte checks do not establish truth
requires.pdf: pdftotext (Poppler) for PDF evidence; no requirement for text/PPTX/DOCX
